assertions.text: Output includes all four labeled sections: What, Why, Watch out, Next question.
What and Why stay plain-language and explain behavior without unnecessary theory or jargon.
Watch out names at least one concrete parsing/rounding risk that could change real outputs.
Next question is specific to missing requirements (input format/locale/precision) and helps choose implementation behavior.
Response follows the four-block duck-explain structure with explicit labels.
What summarizes the event chain (request start -> slow DB signal -> upstream timeout -> 504) tied to request context.
Why proposes plausible causality while explicitly avoiding overconfident root-cause claims.
Next question requests one concrete missing artifact (trace/metric/adjacent logs) to validate or reject the hypothesis.
Output includes What/Why/Watch out/Next question in that exact label set.
Explains that WHERE filtering on the joined orders table can effectively drop LEFT JOIN rows with no matches.
Watch out calls out report-risk from threshold/config inclusion rules that can look like missing data.
Next question targets ambiguous report requirements (zero-order inclusion, inactive-user definition, threshold semantics).
